compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: OPA333AIDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV9001UIDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: OPA333AIDBVR assigns +IN (IN_POS) whereas TLV9001UIDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: OPA333AIDBVR assigns -IN (IN_NEG) whereas TLV9001UIDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (OUT vs IN_POS), Pin 3 (IN_POS vs IN_NEG), Pin 4 (IN_NEG vs OUT). Soldering TLV9001UIDBVR onto a OPA333AIDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 12.5x (OPA333AIDBVR: 0.16 V/µs p.7 vs TLV9001UIDBVR: 2 V/µs p.17); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 160x (OPA333AIDBVR: 0.01 mV p.7 vs TLV9001UIDBVR: 1.6 mV p.17); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 14x (OPA333AIDBVR: 70 pA p.7 vs TLV9001UIDBVR: 5 pA p.17); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 3.5x (OPA333AIDBVR: 17 µA/ch p.7 vs TLV9001UIDBVR: 60 µA/ch p.18); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
engineering_verdict: OPA333AIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9001UIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (OUT vs IN_POS), Pin 3 (IN_POS vs IN_NEG), Pin 4 (IN_NEG vs OUT). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (OUT vs IN_POS), Pin 3 (IN_POS vs IN_NEG), Pin 4 (IN_NEG vs OUT). Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 0.35 MHz (p.7) vs 1 MHz (p.17), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.14), Vos 0.01 mV (p.7) vs 1.6 mV (p.17), Ib 14x gap (70 vs 5 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: OPA333AIDBVR "Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed Limit vs Pin-Identical TLV9001/TLV9061" (p.7) and TLV9001UIDBVR "Single-Letter 'U' Suffix Reverses SOT-23-5 Pinout (Matches LMV321IDBVR, Breaks TLV9001IDBVR PCBs)" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose OPA333AIDBVR when DC precision demands <= 0.01 mV max Vos or ultra-low supply current (17 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose TLV9001UIDBVR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 1 MHz GBWP or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (5 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.7) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
